zh.title: 國防部偵獲18架次中共軍機 13架次逾越海峽中線
zh.summary: 國防部18日偵獲18架次共機出海；13架次逾越海峽中線；國軍嚴密監控應處
body: 國防部於8月18日表示，自上午8時55分起，陸續偵獲中共殲10、殲11、殲16、空警500等各型主、輔戰機計18架次出海。其中13架次逾越台灣海峽中線及其延伸線，進入台灣北部、中部及西南空域，配合共艦執行所謂「聯合戰備警巡」。
國軍對此運用聯合情監偵手段嚴密掌握，並檢派任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統適切應處。此外，國防部統計8月17日上午6時至18日上午6時，亦偵獲共艦8艘、公務船7艘及共機5架次，其中3架次侵擾北部及東部空域。

en.title: Taiwan MND Detects 18 PLA Aircraft and 13 Crossing Strait Median Line
en.summary: Taiwan MND detected 18 PLA aircraft on August 18; 13 crossed the Taiwan Strait median line.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense stated that starting at 8:55 AM on August 18, 18 Chinese military aircraft sorties were detected operating at sea, including J-10, J-11, J-16, and KJ-500 aircraft. Among them, 13 sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait and its extension, entering Taiwan's northern, central, and southwestern airspace in coordination with Chinese naval vessels conducting joint combat readiness patrols.

The Taiwanese military utilized joint intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance systems while deploying mission aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond. Additionally, statistics from 6:00 AM on August 17 to 6:00 AM on August 18 showed that 8 Chinese warships, 7 official vessels, and 5 military aircraft were detected around Taiwan, with 3 aircraft operating in northern and eastern airspace.
